svg.title: Failure search, animated
svg.desc: Synthetic (DSR-12), no evidence credit. Looping failure search for loss of lateral assistance in a highway curve: 120 Monte Carlo runs appear as dots in the order they ran, against curve lateral acceleration and driver reaction time, red where the body edge crossed the lane line (92 of 120) and blue where it stayed in; then the cross-entropy worst case of each of 4 rounds is ringed: cross-entropy round 1: worst rho -7.33 m at a_y 1.80, t_r 1.48 s, 80 km/h; cross-entropy round 2: worst rho -7.25 m at a_y 1.80, t_r 1.50 s, 90 km/h; cross-entropy round 3: worst rho -7.23 m at a_y 1.80, t_r 1.50 s, 96 km/h; cross-entropy round 4: worst rho -7.23 m at a_y 1.80, t_r 1.50 s, 96 km/h. The share of departing runs describes the sampled box, not a probability on the road: the box is uniform by construction. The worst cases rank where bench and closed-course tests look first (WP-V-04 U-4).
svg.text: Failure search: filling in the map
Loss of lateral assistance in a highway curve (EPS fault, F-07), plant model L1. Each
dot is one run; red: the body edge crossed the lane line.
From search.py's committed figure and table · speed, lane width and cue also vary
